records.claim: Antonia adjoins the Temple precinct at the northwest corner and connects to north/west cloisters.
Herodian Temple Mount was expanded north, west and south; Royal Stoa occupied the south.
Exact placement/details of porticoes, barriers, ancillary buildings and Temple proper cannot be treated as archaeologically surveyed geometry.
Later Golden Gate must not be used as certain Herodian eastern gate.
Perimeter cloisters have literary support; this project’s exact lines, gaps at Antonia, bay rhythm, roof thickness and column profile are authored illustrative choices.
records.source: Josephus Jewish War5; John10:23 for the east-portico name; not surveyed geometry
